1.en: There's 104 days of summer vacation, and then school comes along just to end it. So the annual problem for our generation is finding a good way to spend it.
1.zh: 暑假有 104 天，接著學校就來把它結束掉；所以我們這一代每年面臨的問題，就是找個好方法來度過它。

1.en: Like maybe building a rocket, or fighting a mummy, or climbing up the Eiffel Tower.
1.zh: 例如，造一枚火箭、對抗木乃伊，或爬上艾菲爾鐵塔。

1.en: Giving a monkey a shower.
1.zh: 幫猴子洗澡。

1.en: Discovering something that doesn’t exist, or giving a monkey a shower.
1.zh: 發現不存在的東西，或幫猴子洗澡。

1.en: Surfing tidal waves, creating nanobots, or locating Frankenstein’s brain.
1.zh: 衝浪穿越潮汐巨浪、製造奈米機器人，或尋找科學怪人的大腦。

1.en: It’s over here.
1.zh: 它在這裡。

1.en: Finding a dodo bird, painting a continent, or driving your sister insane.
1.zh: 尋找渡渡鳥、在一片大陸上作畫，或把你的姊妹逼瘋。

1.en: As you can see, there’s a whole lot of stuff to do before school starts this fall.
1.zh: 如你所見，在今年秋天開學前，有一大堆事情可以做。

1.en: So stick with us ’cause Phineas and Ferb are gonna do it all.
1.zh: 所以跟我們一起吧，因為 Phineas 和 Ferb 什麼都要做。

1.en: So stick with us ’cause Phineas and Ferb are gonna do it all.
1.zh: 所以跟我們一起吧，因為 Phineas 和 Ferb 什麼都要做。

1.en: Mom! Phineas and Ferb are making a title sequence!
1.zh: 媽媽！Phineas 和 Ferb 正在製作片頭！

1.en: So, Ferb, what do you want to do today?
1.zh: 所以，Ferb，你今天想做什麼？

1.en: What about Perry? What does he want to do?
1.zh: 那 Perry 呢？他想做什麼？

1.en: Well, he’s a platypus. They don’t do much.
1.zh: 嗯，他是鴨嘴獸。他們不太做什麼。

1.en: I for one am starting to get bored, and boredom is something up with which I will not put.
1.zh: 至少我開始覺得無聊了，而無聊是我不能忍受的事。

1.en: The first thing they’re gonna ask us when we get back to school is what did we do over summer?
1.zh: 我們回學校後，他們第一個會問我們的問題就是：暑假做了什麼？

1.en: I mean, no school for 3 months, our life should be a rollercoaster.
1.zh: 我的意思是，三個月不用上學，我們的生活應該要像雲霄飛車一樣刺激。

1.en: And I mean a good rollercoaster.
1.zh: 而且我是說一個好的雲霄飛車。

1.en: Not like that one we rode at the state fair.
1.zh: 不是像我們在州博覽會搭的那一座。

1.en: Please exit to the left.
1.zh: 請從左側離開。

1.en: Man, that was lame.
1.zh: 天啊，那真遜。

1.en: Why, if I built a rollercoaster, I would—
1.zh: 如果是我蓋雲霄飛車的話，我就會——

1.en: That’s it! I know what we’re gonna do today.
1.zh: 就是這樣！我知道我們今天要做什麼了。

1.en: Phineas, Ferb, I’m gonna go pick up a few things.
1.zh: Phineas、Ferb，我要去拿幾樣東西。

1.en: You boys stay out of trouble, OK?
1.zh: 你們兩個不要惹麻煩，好嗎？

1.en: OK, Mom.
1.zh: 好的，媽媽。

1.en: We’re gonna build a rollercoaster.
1.zh: 我們要蓋一座雲霄飛車。

1.en: I’m in charge, right? You did tell them I’m in charge?
1.zh: 我是負責人，對吧？你有告訴他們我是負責人吧？

1.en: Relax, Candace. Nobody has to be in charge.
1.zh: 放輕鬆，Candace。沒有人一定要負責。

1.en: But what if there’s an emergency?
1.zh: 但是，如果發生緊急狀況怎麼辦？

1.en: Like what?
1.zh: 例如什麼？

1.en: What if a satellite falls out of orbit and crashes into the house?!
1.zh: 如果衛星脫離軌道，撞進房子怎麼辦？

1.en: If that happens, you’re in charge.
1.zh: 如果那種事發生，你就負責。

1.en: Yes!
1.zh: 好！／是的！

1.en: Mom says I’m in charge conditionally.
1.zh: 媽媽說我是在有條件下負責。

1.en: Whatever.
1.zh: 隨便。／算了。

1.en: Wait a minute. What are you doing?
1.zh: 等一下。你在做什麼？

1.en: Homework.
1.zh: 作業。

1.en: It’s summer.
1.zh: 現在是夏天。

1.en: That’s cool. You wait till the last minute, then.
1.zh: 那很好啊。那你就等到最後一刻吧。

2.en: No, I can’t go to the mall right now.
2.zh: 不行，我現在不能去購物中心。

2.en: Mom just went to the store.
Oh, if you go, can you see if Jeremy’s there?
2.zh: 喔，如果你要去，可以幫我看看 Jeremy 在不在嗎？

2.en: No, no, he’s the cute one that works at Mr. Slushy Burger.
2.zh: 不，不是，他是那個在 Mr. Slushy Burger 工作的可愛男生。

2.en: Yeah, he totally smiled at me the last time I was there.
2.zh: 對啊，我上次去那裡時，他真的對我笑了。
我差點沒昏倒。／我簡直開心死了。

2.en: I know. I told you, I can’t.
2.zh: 我知道。我跟你說過，我不能去。

2.en: I’m watching my brother and stepbrother.
2.zh: 我正在照顧我的弟弟和繼弟。

2.en: Yeah, and they never get into trouble.
2.zh: 對，而且他們從來不惹麻煩。
因為媽媽從來沒有抓到他們。

2.en: One of these days, though, I’m gonna see to it.
2.zh: 不過，總有一天我要確保這件事發生。

2.en: I am trying to use the phone!
Mom left me in charge, so there will be no shenanigans today.
2.zh: 媽媽讓我負責，所以今天不會有任何搗蛋行為。

2.en: What are they doing right now?
What do you mean you can see it from your house?
2.zh: 你說你從家裡看得到它，是什麼意思？

2.en: Ooh, I’m gonna go tell Mom, and when she sees what you are doing, you are going down!
2.zh: 喔，我要去告訴媽媽；等她看到你在做什麼，你就慘了！

2.en: We’re gonna need a blowtorch and some more peanut butter.
2.zh: 我們需要一支噴火槍和更多花生醬。

2.en: Wow. Isn’t that kind of impossible?
2.zh: 哇，那不是有點不可能嗎？
你的繼弟平常會說話嗎？

2.en: Ferb? He’s more of a man of action.
2.zh: Ferb？他比較像是個實際行動派。

2.en: I was gonna go to the pool.

3.en: You want to go swimming?
3.zh: 你想去游泳嗎？

3.en: Kind of in the middle of something here.
3.zh: 我現在正忙著做某件事。

3.en: Oh. Right.
3.zh: 喔，對。

3.en: OK. I’ll see you later, then.
3.zh: 好，那晚點見。

3.en: OK.
3.zh: 好。

3.en: Hey, Ferb, you got enough rivets up there?
3.zh: 嘿，Ferb，你上面有足夠的鉚釘嗎？

3.en: Hey, where’s Perry?
3.zh: 嘿，Perry 在哪裡？

3.en: Good morning, Agent P.
3.zh: 早安，P 特工。

3.en: The evil doctor is up to his old tricks.
3.zh: 那個邪惡博士又在耍他老套的把戲了。

3.en: For reasons unknown to us, he’s bought up 80% of the country’s tinfoil.
3.zh: 由於我們不知道的原因，他買下了全國百分之八十的錫箔紙。

3.en: I want you to get over to his hideout right away.
3.zh: 我要你立刻到他的藏身處去。

3.en: Find out what he’s up to, and put a stop to it.
3.zh: 查出他在做什麼，並阻止這件事。

3.en: As always, it is imperative that your cover identity...
3.zh: 一如往常，你的掩護身分必須……

3.en: As a mindless domestic pet remains intact.
3.zh: 保持成為一隻無知家養寵物的樣子。

3.en: Now get out there. We’re all counting on you.
3.zh: 現在出發吧。我們都指望你了。

3.en: So the way I see it,
3.zh: 所以依我看來，

3.en: The solid fuel rockets kick in in the mall parking lot.
3.zh: 固體燃料火箭會在購物中心停車場啟動。

3.en: Then we release the snakes during the corkscrew around the interstate.
3.zh: 然後我們在州際公路的螺旋路段釋放蛇。

3.en: I’m gonna go get the snakes.
3.zh: 我要去拿蛇。

3.en: Mom, you’ve gotta come home right now.
3.zh: 媽媽，你現在一定要回家。

3.en: Did a satellite crash into the house?
3.zh: 有衛星撞進房子嗎？

3.en: No, no, no! You gotta see what Phineas and Ferb are doing.
3.zh: 不、不、不！你一定要看看他們在做什麼。

3.en: It seems like we’ve had this conversation before.
3.zh: 我們好像以前談過這件事。

3.en: What do you mean?
3.zh: 你是什麼意思？

3.en: I seem to recall you telling me that the boys were training monkeys to juggle bicycles.
3.zh: 我好像記得你告訴過我，那些男孩正在訓練猴子玩腳踏車雜耍。

3.en: And when I came home, there was a stunning lack of monkeys.
3.zh: 而我回家時，猴子卻完全不見蹤影。

3.en: I still don’t know how they cleaned it up so fast.
3.zh: 我到現在還是不知道他們怎麼那麼快收拾乾淨。

3.en: So what’s the emergency this time?
3.zh: 所以這次的緊急狀況是什麼？

3.en: They’re building a rollercoaster.
3.zh: 他們正在蓋雲霄飛車。

3.en: Candace, seriously, isn’t Phineas a little young to be a rollercoaster engineer?
3.zh: Candace，認真說，Phineas 會不會年紀太小，不適合當雲霄飛車工程師？

3.en: Aren’t you a little young to be a rollercoaster engineer?
3.zh: 你是不是年紀太小，不適合當雲霄飛車工程師？

3.en: Yes. Yes, I am.
3.zh: 是的，是的，我是。

3.en: Well, I must say, I’m very impressed.
3.zh: 嗯，我得說，我印象非常深刻。

3.en: The forms all seem to be in order.
3.zh: 所有表格看起來都沒問題。

3.en: Although I’ve never seen them filled out in crayon before.
3.zh: 雖然我以前從沒看過有人用蠟筆填表格。

3.en: So if there’s anything I can get you,
3.zh: 所以如果有任何我可以拿給你的東西，

3.en: Anything at all, just let me know.
3.zh: 任何東西都可以，告訴我就好。

3.en: Do you think we could borrow one of those gadgets?
3.zh: 你覺得我們可以借用其中一個工具嗎？

3.en: Now, this is the life.
3.zh: 這才叫生活。

3.en: Ah, Perry the Platypus.
3.zh: 啊，Perry the Platypus。

4.en: What an unexpected surprise.
4.zh: 真是意想不到的驚喜。

4.en: And by unexpected, I mean completely expected!
4.zh: 我說「意想不到」，意思其實是完全預料之中！

4.en: I have covered the entire Eastern Seaboard in tinfoil.
4.zh: 我已經用錫箔紙覆蓋了整個東海岸。

4.en: And when I put my giant magnet next to my ingenious magnetism magnifier,
4.zh: 而當我把巨大的磁鐵放在我巧妙的磁力放大器旁邊時，

4.en: I will pull the east in a westerly direction.
4.zh: 我會把東方拉向西方。

4.en: Thereby reversing rotation of the earth.
4.zh: 從而反轉地球的自轉。

4.en: You may well ask yourself.
4.zh: 你很可能會問自己。

4.en: Why would he do this?
4.zh: 他為什麼要做這件事？

4.en: What could he possibly have to gain?
4.zh: 他到底可能得到什麼好處？

4.en: I haven’t really worked out all the bugs yet.
4.zh: 我還沒有真正把所有問題解決。

4.en: I mean, you know.
4.zh: 我的意思是，你知道。

4.en: This one alone cost a lot.
4.zh: 光是這一個就花了很多錢。

4.en: But, Mom, I tell you, they’re building it and it’s huge!
4.zh: 但是，媽媽，我跟你說，他們正在蓋，而且大得不得了！

4.en: Phineas and Ferb present the coolest coaster ever. Now open.
4.zh: Phineas 和 Ferb 呈獻史上最酷的雲霄飛車。現在開放。

4.en: Mom!
4.zh: 媽媽！

4.en: Phineas and Ferb got a rollercoaster?
4.zh: Phineas 和 Ferb 蓋了雲霄飛車？

4.en: You think we get a discount if we bring the flier?
4.zh: 你覺得如果我們帶傳單去，會有折扣嗎？

4.en: I think we better take it.
4.zh: 我覺得我們最好拿走它。

4.en: Here. Look, look, look. See?
4.zh: 給你。看、看、看。看到了嗎？

4.en: I told you I’m not crazy. I told you.
4.zh: 我就說我不是瘋了。我跟你說過了。

4.en: I see your point, Candace.
4.zh: 我懂你的意思，Candace。

4.en: No crazy person would scream at a post like that.
4.zh: 沒有哪個瘋子會對著那樣的柱子尖叫。

4.en: I’ll be in the dairy section if you want to come yell at some cheese or anything.
4.zh: 如果你想來對著起司喊叫，我會在乳製品區。

4.en: Ladies and gentlemen.
4.zh: 女士先生們。

4.en: Boys and girls.
4.zh: 男孩女孩們。

4.en: Children of all ages.
4.zh: 各個年齡的孩子們。

4.en: May I present to you a spectacle?
4.zh: 我可以向各位呈獻一場壯觀的表演嗎？

4.en: Most of the morning in the making.
4.zh: 花了大半個早上製作完成。

4.en: The coolest coaster ever!
4.zh: 史上最酷的雲霄飛車！

4.en: So, who wants to go first?
4.zh: 所以，誰想先來？

4.en: To fasten, insert the tab into the metal buckle.
4.zh: 要扣緊時，把扣片插入金屬扣環。

4.en: To release, just pull back on the—oops.
4.zh: 要解開時，只要往後拉——糟糕。

4.en: Well, you get the picture.
4.zh: 好吧，你懂我的意思了。

4.en: Well, that’s about it.
4.zh: 大概就是這樣。

4.en: Enjoy the ride.
4.zh: 享受這趟旅程。

4.en: You all signed the waivers, right?
4.zh: 你們都簽好免責同意書了，對吧？

4.en: Relax, they’re just rubber.
4.zh: 放輕鬆，它們只是橡膠。

4.en: But I really make all my money back.
4.zh: 但我真的會把錢全部賺回來。

4.en: I could buy a bunch of east-facing real estate and sell it again.
4.zh: 我可以買一大堆面向東方的房地產，再把它賣掉。

4.en: Hah! You missed!
4.zh: 哈！你沒打中！

5.en: How do you like the lanai?
5.zh: 你覺得這個陽台怎麼樣？

5.en: Quake in your boots and watch helplessly as the electromagnetic forces pull the eastern seaboard.
5.zh: 嚇得發抖吧，無助地看著電磁力拉動東海岸。

5.en: Thereby reversing rotation of the earth.
Well... that didn’t work.
And now we have a two-ton ball of tinfoil traveling 200 miles an hour directly at us!
5.zh: 現在我們有一顆兩噸重的錫箔球，以每小時兩百英里的速度直接朝我們而來！

5.en: Quickly! We must separate the magnet from the magnifier.
5.zh: 快！我們必須把磁鐵和放大器分開。

5.en: Now, I know I have that club card in here somewhere.
5.zh: 我知道我的會員卡就在這裡某個地方。

5.en: I always have it with me, but my purse is such a disaster area.
5.zh: 我總是隨身帶著它，但我的皮包簡直像災區。

5.en: You know how it is.
It’s no use! We are doomed!
You saved us, Perry the Platypus!
Bless you, Perry the Platypus!
5.zh: 願你受到祝福，Perry the Platypus！

5.en: Look, look, look, look! See?
OK, I give up.
What am I supposed to be looking at?
No! It’s not possible!
I’m gonna go get the cart.
Time to go. I’ve got frozen.
So you think that Phineas and Ferb are still under that stupid tree in the backyard, right?
5.zh: 所以你覺得他們還在後院那棵討厭的樹下，對吧？

5.en: Well, yes, that would be my guess.
Fine. Then let’s go home—now!
Oh, there you are, Perry.
Nice hat, Isabella.
Funny. I don’t remember this in the blueprints.
5.zh: 真奇怪。我不記得藍圖上有這個。

5.en: And I’m sure this is new.
I worry about you sometimes, Candace.
Welcome to Mr. Slushy Burger. May I take your order?
5.zh: 歡迎來到 Mr. Slushy Burger。可以幫你點餐嗎？

5.en: Anyone want fries?
Anyone want a croissant?
You know, if that thing crashes to earth, Candace is in charge.
5.zh: 你知道，如果那個東西墜落到地球，Candace 就負責。

5.en: We should have charged more.
5.zh: 我們本來應該收更多錢。

5.en: OK, we’re here. Are you happy now, Candace?
5.zh: 好了，我們到了。你現在滿意了嗎？

5.en: Yes! See, Mom? I told you they weren’t there.
5.zh: 對！你看，媽媽？我就說他們不在那裡。

5.en: Hi, Mom.
Oh, hi, boys.
Come on, Candace, help me with the groceries.
Let’s go.
Hey, Phineas, that was great.
Way too cool.
Can we do it again?

6.en: Sorry. Only one ride per customer.
6.zh: 抱歉，每位客人只能搭一次。

6.en: So, what are you gonna do tomorrow?
Maybe you can teach Perry some tricks.
6.zh: 也許你可以教 Perry 一些技巧。

6.en: They’re the only mammals to lay eggs.
6.zh: 牠們是唯一會下蛋的哺乳類。

6.en: It really was the coolest coaster ever.
6.zh: 它真的就是史上最酷的雲霄飛車。

6.en: You guys make a great team.
6.zh: 你們組成了一個很棒的團隊。

6.en: Well, a brother is a brother.
But I couldn’t have asked for a better one than Ferb.
6.zh: 但我不可能要求有比 Ferb 更好的兄弟了。

6.en: Oh, man! I can smell the peanut butter.
6.zh: 天啊！我聞得到花生醬的味道。

6.en: So what should we do tomorrow?
6.zh: 所以我們明天應該做什麼？

6.en: Maybe we should make a list.
6.zh: 也許我們應該列一張清單。
今天是 Candace 的生日。

6.en: We’ve gotta do better than last year.
6.zh: 我們一定要比去年做得更好。

6.en: This time it’s gotta be something huge.
6.zh: 這次一定要是很大的東西。

6.en: I made you a special breakfast.
6.zh: 我為你做了特別的早餐。

6.en: And after that, we have a surprise.
6.zh: 而且在那之後，我們有一個驚喜。

6.en: What is it? Where is it?
We have to drive to it.
OK. But it’s the mall, right?
6.zh: 好吧。但它是購物中心，對吧？

6.en: Wait. Please don’t tell me we’re going to Mt. Rushmore.
6.zh: 等等。拜託不要告訴我我們要去拉什莫爾山。

7.en: Four American presidents carved into the side of a mountain.
7.zh: 四位美國總統被雕刻在山的側面。

7.en: It was Phineas’ and Ferb’s idea.
7.zh: 這是 Phineas 和 Ferb 的主意。

7.en: OK, you lot go on ahead.
I’ll find a parking spot and meet you there.
7.zh: 我會找停車位，然後在那裡和你們會合。

7.en: We’re going up to the monument. Come on, Perry.
7.zh: 我們要上紀念碑那裡。來吧，Perry。

7.en: OK. We’ll join you in a minute.
7.zh: 好，我們一分鐘後去找你們。

7.en: You can pick out anything you want.
7.zh: 你可以挑任何你想要的東西。

7.en: What about the Mt. Rushmore bobblehead?
7.zh: 拉什莫爾山的搖頭公仔怎麼樣？

7.en: OK. How about this cute, cuddly Lincoln?
7.zh: 好吧。這個可愛又好抱的林肯公仔怎麼樣？

7.en: Oh, I’m just here on the worker exchange program.
7.zh: 喔，我只是因為員工交換計畫來這裡。

7.en: Uh-oh—well, it’s my birthday today, and I...
7.zh: 糟了——嗯，今天是我的生日，而且我……
是什麼風把你們女孩帶到這裡？

7.en: He and Ferb are up at the monument.
7.zh: 他和 Ferb 在紀念碑那裡。

7.en: Dr. Doofenshmirtz is up to no good again.
7.zh: Doofenshmirtz 博士又在做壞事了。

7.en: We’ve just discovered his new hideout is located inside Lincoln’s head at Mt. Rushmore.
7.zh: 我們剛發現他的新藏身處位於拉什莫爾山林肯的頭裡。

7.en: Poor planning on our part, actually. Sorry.
7.zh: 其實是我們這邊規畫得不好。抱歉。

7.en: Hey, honey, what are them kids doing up on the monument?
7.zh: 嘿，親愛的，那些孩子在紀念碑上做什麼？

7.en: Mom, you have got to see this now.
7.zh: 媽媽，你現在一定要看看這個。

8.en: I’m just gonna go back to the gift shop.
You are just in time to witness my latest scheme.
8.zh: 你來得正好，可以見證我最新的陰謀。

8.en: I will bore a tunnel to China.
8.zh: 我要鑽一條通往中國的隧道。

8.en: So, as they say in China...

8.zh: 那麼，我們現在應該從哪裡開始？
我們可以找一個瞭望員。

8.en: If you handle the big stick, you gotta buy it.
8.zh: 如果你拿了那根大棍子，你就得買下它。

8.en: Mom! You’ve gotta see what Phineas and Ferb are doing!
8.zh: 媽媽！你一定要看看他們在做什麼！

8.en: Aren’t you boys a little young to be restoring a national monument?
8.zh: 你們是不是年紀太小，不適合修復國家紀念碑？

8.en: It’s good to see young people taking an interest in our national heritage.
8.zh: 看到年輕人對國家文化遺產感興趣，真是很好。

8.en: The molten lava of the earth’s core completely slipped my mind.
8.zh: 地核的熔岩完全被我忘了。

8.en: Oh, no! The lava is following us!
8.zh: 糟糕！熔岩正在跟著我們！

8.en: You did it, Perry the Platypus.
I hate to be a stickler, but the lava is coming.
8.zh: 我不想太挑剔，但熔岩正在靠近。

8.en: Wait till you see what those two are up to.
8.zh: 等你看到那兩個人在搞什麼。

8.en: We’re running a little behind schedule.

8.zh: 女孩們，執行 B 計畫！

8.en: You are going to be shocked by what I’m about to show you, Mom.
8.zh: 媽媽，你看到我即將展示的東西一定會震驚。

8.en: Hmm. I guess some things look better in photos.
8.zh: 嗯，我想有些東西在照片裡看起來比較好。

8.en: I found an absolutely brilliant parking space.
8.zh: 我找到一個非常棒的停車位。

8.en: Great. I’ll meet you at the gift shop, dear.
8.zh: 很好。我會在禮品店和你會合，親愛的。

8.en: I still have to buy that big stick.

9.en: Candace, are you still trying to get the boys in trouble?
9.zh: Candace，你還在試著讓男孩們惹上麻煩嗎？

9.en: No! No, no, this is a great thing.
It’s the nicest thing anyone has ever done for me!
9.zh: 這是任何人為我做過最好的事！

9.en: You know, Candace, this is the second time I’ve climbed up there.
9.zh: 你知道嗎，Candace，這是我第二次爬上去。

9.en: I’m already down half a dress size.
9.zh: 我已經少了半個衣服尺寸。

9.en: Now, what is it you wanted me to see?
Now, let’s go find your father.
9.zh: 現在，我們去找你爸爸吧。

9.en: Did you like your birthday present?
9.zh: 你喜歡你的生日禮物嗎？

9.en: Well, it was definitely better than the gorilla in the cake.
9.zh: 嗯，它絕對比蛋糕裡的大猩猩好。

9.en: Hey, Candace, I had a break and I thought I’d give you this for your birthday.
9.zh: 嘿，Candace，我休息時想說把這個當生日禮物送給你。

9.en: I saw you looking at it in the gift shop.
9.zh: 我看到你在禮品店看著它。
一個拉什莫爾山搖頭公仔。

9.en: This was the best birthday ever.
9.zh: 這是有史以來最棒的生日。

10.en: There's 104 days of summer vacation, and then school comes along just to end it. So the annual problem for our generation is finding a good way to spend it.
10.zh: 暑假有 104 天，接著學校就來把它結束掉；所以我們這一代每年面臨的問題，就是找個好方法來度過它。

10.en: Like maybe building a rocket, or fighting a mummy, or climbing up the Eiffel Tower.
10.zh: 例如，造一枚火箭、對抗木乃伊，或爬上艾菲爾鐵塔。

10.en: Giving a monkey a shower.
Discovering something that doesn’t exist, or giving a monkey a shower.
10.zh: 發現不存在的東西，或幫猴子洗澡。

10.en: Surfing tidal waves, creating nanobots, or locating Frankenstein’s brain.
10.zh: 衝浪穿越潮汐巨浪、製造奈米機器人，或尋找科學怪人的大腦。

10.en: It’s over here.
Finding a dodo bird, painting a continent, or driving your sister insane.
10.zh: 尋找渡渡鳥、在一片大陸上作畫，或把你的姊妹逼瘋。

10.en: As you can see, there’s a whole lot of stuff to do before school starts this fall.
10.zh: 如你所見，在今年秋天開學前，有一大堆事情可以做。

10.en: So stick with us ’cause Phineas and Ferb are gonna do it all.
10.zh: 所以跟我們一起吧，因為 Phineas 和 Ferb 什麼都要做。

10.en: So stick with us ’cause Phineas and Ferb are gonna do it all.
10.zh: 所以跟我們一起吧，因為 Phineas 和 Ferb 什麼都要做。

10.en: Mom! Phineas and Ferb are making a title sequence!
10.zh: 媽媽！Phineas 和 Ferb 正在製作片頭！

10.en: So, Ferb, what do you want to do today?
What about Perry? What does he want to do?
10.zh: 那 Perry 呢？他想做什麼？

10.en: Well, he’s a platypus. They don’t do much.
10.zh: 嗯，他是鴨嘴獸。他們不太做什麼。

10.en: I for one am starting to get bored, and boredom is something up with which I will not put.
10.zh: 至少我開始覺得無聊了，而無聊是我不能忍受的事。

10.en: The first thing they’re gonna ask us when we get back to school is what did we do over summer?
10.zh: 我們回學校後，他們第一個會問我們的問題就是：暑假做了什麼？

10.en: I mean, no school for 3 months, our life should be a rollercoaster.
10.zh: 我的意思是，三個月不用上學，我們的生活應該要像雲霄飛車一樣刺激。

10.en: And I mean a good rollercoaster.
10.zh: 而且我是說一個好的雲霄飛車。

10.en: Not like that one we rode at the state fair.
10.zh: 不是像我們在州博覽會搭的那一座。

10.en: Please exit to the left.
Man, that was lame.
Why, if I built a rollercoaster, I would—
10.zh: 如果是我蓋雲霄飛車的話，我就會——

10.en: That’s it! I know what we’re gonna do today.
10.zh: 就是這樣！我知道我們今天要做什麼了。

10.en: Phineas, Ferb, I’m gonna go pick up a few things.
You boys stay out of trouble, OK?
10.zh: 你們兩個不要惹麻煩，好嗎？

10.en: OK, Mom.
We’re gonna build a rollercoaster.
10.zh: 我們要蓋一座雲霄飛車。

10.en: I’m in charge, right? You did tell them I’m in charge?
10.zh: 我是負責人，對吧？你有告訴他們我是負責人吧？

10.en: Relax, Candace. Nobody has to be in charge.
10.zh: 放輕鬆，Candace。沒有人一定要負責。

10.en: But what if there’s an emergency?
10.zh: 但是，如果發生緊急狀況怎麼辦？

10.en: Like what?
What if a satellite falls out of orbit and crashes into the house?!
10.zh: 如果衛星脫離軌道，撞進房子怎麼辦？

10.en: If that happens, you’re in charge.
10.zh: 如果那種事發生，你就負責。

10.en: Yes!
Mom says I’m in charge conditionally.
10.zh: 媽媽說我是在有條件下負責。

10.en: Whatever.
Wait a minute. What are you doing?
Homework.
It’s summer.
That’s cool. You wait till the last minute, then.
10.zh: 那很好啊。那你就等到最後一刻吧。

10.en: Well, I’m watching you.
And I’m in charge.
Conditionally!
Hello?
Oh, hi, Cece.
No, I can’t go to the mall right now.
10.zh: 不行，我現在不能去購物中心。

10.en: Mom just went to the store.
She left me in charge.
Well, you know, conditionally.
Oh, if you go, can you see if Jeremy’s there?
10.zh: 喔，如果你要去，可以幫我看看 Jeremy 在不在嗎？

10.en: No, no, he’s the cute one that works at Mr. Slushy Burger.
10.zh: 不，不是，他是那個在 Mr. Slushy Burger 工作的可愛男生。

10.en: Yeah, he totally smiled at me the last time I was there.
10.zh: 對啊，我上次去那裡時，他真的對我笑了。

10.en: I just about died.
10.zh: 我差點沒昏倒。／我簡直開心死了。

10.en: I know. I told you, I can’t.
10.zh: 我知道。我跟你說過，我不能去。

10.en: I’m watching my brother and stepbrother.
10.zh: 我正在照顧我的弟弟和繼弟。

10.en: Yeah, and they never get into trouble.
10.zh: 對，而且他們從來不惹麻煩。

10.en: Because Mom never catches them.
10.zh: 因為媽媽從來沒有抓到他們。

10.en: One of these days, though, I’m gonna see to it.
10.zh: 不過，總有一天我要確保這件事發生。

10.en: That she catches them red-handed.
Will you hold it down!
I am trying to use the phone!
Mom left me in charge, so there will be no shenanigans today.
10.zh: 媽媽讓我負責，所以今天不會有任何搗蛋行為。

10.en: What are they doing right now?
Why do you ask?
What do you mean you can see it from your house?
10.zh: 你說你從家裡看得到它，是什麼意思？

10.en: See what?!
Phineas, what is that?
Do you like it?
Ooh, I’m gonna go tell Mom, and when she sees what you are doing, you are going down!
10.zh: 喔，我要去告訴媽媽；等她看到你在做什麼，你就慘了！

10.en: We’re gonna need a blowtorch and some more peanut butter.
10.zh: 我們需要一支噴火槍和更多花生醬。

10.en: Hey, Isabella.
Building a rollercoaster.
In your backyard?
Some of it.
Wow. Isn’t that kind of impossible?
10.zh: 哇，那不是有點不可能嗎？

10.en: Some might say.
Hey, Ferb.
Does your stepbrother ever talk?
10.zh: 你的繼弟平常會說話嗎？

10.en: Ferb? He’s more of a man of action.
10.zh: Ferb？他比較像是個實際行動派。

10.en: I was gonna go to the pool.
You want to go swimming?
Kind of in the middle of something here.
10.zh: 我現在正忙著做某件事。

10.en: Oh. Right.
OK. I’ll see you later, then.
OK.
Hey, Ferb, you got enough rivets up there?
10.zh: 嘿，Ferb，你上面有足夠的鉚釘嗎？

10.en: Hey, where’s Perry?
Good morning, Agent P.
The evil doctor is up to his old tricks.
10.zh: 那個邪惡博士又在耍他老套的把戲了。

10.en: For reasons unknown to us, he’s bought up 80% of the country’s tinfoil.
10.zh: 由於我們不知道的原因，他買下了全國百分之八十的錫箔紙。

10.en: I want you to get over to his hideout right away.
10.zh: 我要你立刻到他的藏身處去。

10.en: Find out what he’s up to, and put a stop to it.
10.zh: 查出他在做什麼，並阻止這件事。

10.en: As always, it is imperative that your cover identity...
10.zh: 一如往常，你的掩護身分必須……

10.en: As a mindless domestic pet remains intact.
10.zh: 保持成為一隻無知家養寵物的樣子。

10.en: Now get out there. We’re all counting on you.
10.zh: 現在出發吧。我們都指望你了。

10.en: So the way I see it,
The solid fuel rockets kick in in the mall parking lot.
10.zh: 固體燃料火箭會在購物中心停車場啟動。

10.en: Then we release the snakes during the corkscrew around the interstate.
10.zh: 然後我們在州際公路的螺旋路段釋放蛇。

10.en: I’m gonna go get the snakes.
Mom, you’ve gotta come home right now.
10.zh: 媽媽，你現在一定要回家。

10.en: Did a satellite crash into the house?
No, no, no! You gotta see what Phineas and Ferb are doing.
10.zh: 不、不、不！你一定要看看他們在做什麼。

10.en: It seems like we’ve had this conversation before.
10.zh: 我們好像以前談過這件事。

10.en: What do you mean?
I seem to recall you telling me that the boys were training monkeys to juggle bicycles.
10.zh: 我好像記得你告訴過我，那些男孩正在訓練猴子玩腳踏車雜耍。

10.en: And when I came home, there was a stunning lack of monkeys.
10.zh: 而我回家時，猴子卻完全不見蹤影。

10.en: I still don’t know how they cleaned it up so fast.
10.zh: 我到現在還是不知道他們怎麼那麼快收拾乾淨。

10.en: So what’s the emergency this time?
10.zh: 所以這次的緊急狀況是什麼？

10.en: They’re building a rollercoaster.
Candace, seriously, isn’t Phineas a little young to be a rollercoaster engineer?
10.zh: Candace，認真說，Phineas 會不會年紀太小，不適合當雲霄飛車工程師？

10.en: Aren’t you a little young to be a rollercoaster engineer?
10.zh: 你是不是年紀太小，不適合當雲霄飛車工程師？

10.en: Yes. Yes, I am.
Well, I must say, I’m very impressed.
10.zh: 嗯，我得說，我印象非常深刻。

10.en: The forms all seem to be in order.
10.zh: 所有表格看起來都沒問題。

10.en: Although I’ve never seen them filled out in crayon before.
10.zh: 雖然我以前從沒看過有人用蠟筆填表格。

10.en: So if there’s anything I can get you,
10.zh: 所以如果有任何我可以拿給你的東西，

10.en: Anything at all, just let me know.
10.zh: 任何東西都可以，告訴我就好。

10.en: Do you think we could borrow one of those gadgets?
10.zh: 你覺得我們可以借用其中一個工具嗎？

10.en: Now, this is the life.
Ah, Perry the Platypus.
What an unexpected surprise.
And by unexpected, I mean completely expected!
10.zh: 我說「意想不到」，意思其實是完全預料之中！

10.en: I have covered the entire Eastern Seaboard in tinfoil.
10.zh: 我已經用錫箔紙覆蓋了整個東海岸。

10.en: And when I put my giant magnet next to my ingenious magnetism magnifier,
10.zh: 而當我把巨大的磁鐵放在我巧妙的磁力放大器旁邊時，

10.en: I will pull the east in a westerly direction.
Thereby reversing rotation of the earth.
You may well ask yourself.
Why would he do this?
What could he possibly have to gain?
10.zh: 他到底可能得到什麼好處？

10.en: I haven’t really worked out all the bugs yet.
10.zh: 我還沒有真正把所有問題解決。

10.en: I mean, you know.
This one alone cost a lot.
10.zh: 光是這一個就花了很多錢。

10.en: But, Mom, I tell you, they’re building it and it’s huge!
10.zh: 但是，媽媽，我跟你說，他們正在蓋，而且大得不得了！

10.en: Phineas and Ferb present the coolest coaster ever. Now open.
10.zh: Phineas 和 Ferb 呈獻史上最酷的雲霄飛車。現在開放。

10.en: Mom!
Phineas and Ferb got a rollercoaster?
10.zh: Phineas 和 Ferb 蓋了雲霄飛車？

10.en: You think we get a discount if we bring the flier?
10.zh: 你覺得如果我們帶傳單去，會有折扣嗎？

10.en: I think we better take it.
10.zh: 我覺得我們最好拿走它。

10.en: Here. Look, look, look. See?
I told you I’m not crazy. I told you.
10.zh: 我就說我不是瘋了。我跟你說過了。

10.en: I see your point, Candace.
No crazy person would scream at a post like that.
10.zh: 沒有哪個瘋子會對著那樣的柱子尖叫。

10.en: I’ll be in the dairy section if you want to come yell at some cheese or anything.
10.zh: 如果你想來對著起司喊叫，我會在乳製品區。

10.en: Ladies and gentlemen.
Boys and girls.
Children of all ages.
May I present to you a spectacle?
10.zh: 我可以向各位呈獻一場壯觀的表演嗎？

10.en: Most of the morning in the making.
10.zh: 花了大半個早上製作完成。

10.en: The coolest coaster ever!
So, who wants to go first?
To fasten, insert the tab into the metal buckle.
10.zh: 要扣緊時，把扣片插入金屬扣環。

10.en: To release, just pull back on the—oops.
10.zh: 要解開時，只要往後拉——糟糕。

10.en: Well, you get the picture.
Well, that’s about it.
Enjoy the ride.
You all signed the waivers, right?
10.zh: 你們都簽好免責同意書了，對吧？

10.en: Relax, they’re just rubber.
But I really make all my money back.
10.zh: 但我真的會把錢全部賺回來。

10.en: I could buy a bunch of east-facing real estate and sell it again.
10.zh: 我可以買一大堆面向東方的房地產，再把它賣掉。

10.en: Hah! You missed!
How do you like the lanai?
10.zh: 你覺得這個陽台怎麼樣？

10.en: Quake in your boots and watch helplessly as the electromagnetic forces pull the eastern seaboard.
10.zh: 嚇得發抖吧，無助地看著電磁力拉動東海岸。

10.en: Thereby reversing rotation of the earth.
Well... that didn’t work.
And now we have a two-ton ball of tinfoil traveling 200 miles an hour directly at us!
10.zh: 現在我們有一顆兩噸重的錫箔球，以每小時兩百英里的速度直接朝我們而來！

10.en: Quickly! We must separate the magnet from the magnifier.
10.zh: 快！我們必須把磁鐵和放大器分開。

10.en: Now, I know I have that club card in here somewhere.
10.zh: 我知道我的會員卡就在這裡某個地方。

10.en: I always have it with me, but my purse is such a disaster area.
10.zh: 我總是隨身帶著它，但我的皮包簡直像災區。

10.en: You know how it is.
It’s no use! We are doomed!
You saved us, Perry the Platypus!
Bless you, Perry the Platypus!
10.zh: 願你受到祝福，Perry the Platypus！

10.en: Look, look, look, look! See?
OK, I give up.
What am I supposed to be looking at?
No! It’s not possible!
I’m gonna go get the cart.
Time to go. I’ve got frozen.
So you think that Phineas and Ferb are still under that stupid tree in the backyard, right?
10.zh: 所以你覺得他們還在後院那棵討厭的樹下，對吧？

10.en: Well, yes, that would be my guess.
Fine. Then let’s go home—now!
Oh, there you are, Perry.
Nice hat, Isabella.
Funny. I don’t remember this in the blueprints.
10.zh: 真奇怪。我不記得藍圖上有這個。

10.en: And I’m sure this is new.
I worry about you sometimes, Candace.
Welcome to Mr. Slushy Burger. May I take your order?
10.zh: 歡迎來到 Mr. Slushy Burger。可以幫你點餐嗎？

10.en: Anyone want fries?
Anyone want a croissant?
You know, if that thing crashes to earth, Candace is in charge.
10.zh: 你知道，如果那個東西墜落到地球，Candace 就負責。

10.en: We should have charged more.
10.zh: 我們本來應該收更多錢。

10.en: OK, we’re here. Are you happy now, Candace?
10.zh: 好了，我們到了。你現在滿意了嗎？

10.en: Yes! See, Mom? I told you they weren’t there.
10.zh: 對！你看，媽媽？我就說他們不在那裡。

10.en: Hi, Mom.
Oh, hi, boys.
Come on, Candace, help me with the groceries.
Let’s go.
Hey, Phineas, that was great.
Way too cool.
Can we do it again?
Sorry. Only one ride per customer.
10.zh: 抱歉，每位客人只能搭一次。

10.en: That was great, Phineas.
So, what are you gonna do tomorrow?
Don’t know yet.
Maybe you can teach Perry some tricks.
10.zh: 也許你可以教 Perry 一些技巧。

10.en: Well, he is a platypus.
They don’t do much.
They’re the only mammals to lay eggs.
10.zh: 牠們是唯一會下蛋的哺乳類。

10.en: Maybe he’ll lay an egg.
Cool. See you tomorrow.
It really was the coolest coaster ever.
10.zh: 它真的就是史上最酷的雲霄飛車。

10.en: You guys make a great team.
10.zh: 你們組成了一個很棒的團隊。

10.en: Well, a brother is a brother.
But I couldn’t have asked for a better one than Ferb.
10.zh: 但我不可能要求有比 Ferb 更好的兄弟了。

10.en: You know what I mean?
Oh, man! I can smell the peanut butter.
10.zh: 天啊！我聞得到花生醬的味道。

10.en: Well, that was impressive.
See you, guys.
So what should we do tomorrow?
10.zh: 所以我們明天應該做什麼？

10.en: There’s a world of possibilities.
Maybe we should make a list.
10.zh: 也許我們應該列一張清單。

10.en: Give it a rest, Candace!
Yes! Hey, Ferb!
It’s Candace’s birthday.
10.zh: 今天是 Candace 的生日。

10.en: We’ve gotta do better than last year.
10.zh: 我們一定要比去年做得更好。

10.en: Not our best work.
This time it’s gotta be something huge.
10.zh: 這次一定要是很大的東西。

10.en: Perry?
This is yours, I believe.
Happy birthday, Candace.
I made you a special breakfast.
10.zh: 我為你做了特別的早餐。

10.en: And after that, we have a surprise.
10.zh: 而且在那之後，我們有一個驚喜。

10.en: What is it? Where is it?
We have to drive to it.
Is it the mall?
No.
OK. But it’s the mall, right?
10.zh: 好吧。但它是購物中心，對吧？

10.en: No, it’s not the mall.
Wait. Please don’t tell me we’re going to Mt. Rushmore.
10.zh: 等等。拜託不要告訴我我們要去拉什莫爾山。

10.en: Isn’t it great?
Four American presidents carved into the side of a mountain.
10.zh: 四位美國總統被雕刻在山的側面。

10.en: It was Phineas’ and Ferb’s idea.
10.zh: 這是 Phineas 和 Ferb 的主意。

10.en: You’re welcome.
OK, you lot go on ahead.
I’ll find a parking spot and meet you there.
10.zh: 我會找停車位，然後在那裡和你們會合。

10.en: We’re going up to the monument. Come on, Perry.
10.zh: 我們要上紀念碑那裡。來吧，Perry。

10.en: OK. We’ll join you in a minute.
10.zh: 好，我們一分鐘後去找你們。

10.en: OK, Candace, it’s your birthday.
You can pick out anything you want.
10.zh: 你可以挑任何你想要的東西。

10.en: What about the Mt. Rushmore bobblehead?
10.zh: 拉什莫爾山的搖頭公仔怎麼樣？

10.en: Mom, that’s lame.
OK. How about this cute, cuddly Lincoln?
10.zh: 好吧。這個可愛又好抱的林肯公仔怎麼樣？

10.en: Hi, Jeremy.
Hey, Candace.
What are you doing here?
Oh, I’m just here on the worker exchange program.
10.zh: 喔，我只是因為員工交換計畫來這裡。

10.en: Uh-oh—well, it’s my birthday today, and I...
10.zh: 糟了——嗯，今天是我的生日，而且我……

10.en: I gotta check something.
Back in a flash, OK?
Where did they go?
Hi, Mrs. Fletcher.
Oh, hi, Isabella.
What brings you girls here?
10.zh: 是什麼風把你們女孩帶到這裡？

10.en: Fireside Girls field trip.
Is Phineas here?
He and Ferb are up at the monument.
10.zh: 他和 Ferb 在紀念碑那裡。

10.en: Possibilities.
Hey, where’s Perry?
Dr. Doofenshmirtz is up to no good again.
10.zh: Doofenshmirtz 博士又在做壞事了。

10.en: We’ve just discovered his new hideout is located inside Lincoln’s head at Mt. Rushmore.
10.zh: 我們剛發現他的新藏身處位於拉什莫爾山林肯的頭裡。

10.en: I know.
You were just there.
Poor planning on our part, actually. Sorry.
10.zh: 其實是我們這邊規畫得不好。抱歉。

10.en: Hey, honey, what are them kids doing up on the monument?
10.zh: 嘿，親愛的，那些孩子在紀念碑上做什麼？

10.en: Let me see that.
Mom, you have got to see this now.
10.zh: 媽媽，你現在一定要看看這個。

10.en: Here, look.
Oop. Ran out of time.
Here, look now.
Oh! Old Reliable Geyser.
How exciting.
I’m just gonna go back to the gift shop.
Your timing is impeccable.
And by impeccable, I mean...
You are just in time to witness my latest scheme.
10.zh: 你來得正好，可以見證我最新的陰謀。

10.en: I will bore a tunnel to China.
10.zh: 我要鑽一條通往中國的隧道。

10.en: Build a toll highway.
So, as they say in China...
Now, where should we start?
10.zh: 那麼，我們現在應該從哪裡開始？

10.en: It’s a surprise.
We could use a lookout.
10.zh: 我們可以找一個瞭望員。

10.en: Can I help?
You got it.
If you handle the big stick, you gotta buy it.
10.zh: 如果你拿了那根大棍子，你就得買下它。

10.en: Mom! You’ve gotta see what Phineas and Ferb are doing!
10.zh: 媽媽！你一定要看看他們在做什麼！

10.en: Aren’t you boys a little young to be restoring a national monument?
10.zh: 你們是不是年紀太小，不適合修復國家紀念碑？

10.en: Yes. Yes, we are.
It’s good to see young people taking an interest in our national heritage.
10.zh: 看到年輕人對國家文化遺產感興趣，真是很好。

10.en: The molten lava of the earth’s core completely slipped my mind.
10.zh: 地核的熔岩完全被我忘了。

10.en: Oh, no! The lava is following us!
10.zh: 糟糕！熔岩正在跟著我們！

10.en: The lava is being diverted.
You did it, Perry the Platypus.
I hate to be a stickler, but the lava is coming.
10.zh: 我不想太挑剔，但熔岩正在靠近。

10.en: Blast-off!
Wait till you see what those two are up to.
10.zh: 等你看到那兩個人在搞什麼。

10.en: She’s coming!
She’s getting closer!
We’re running a little behind schedule.
Go to Plan B.
Plan B, girls!
10.zh: 女孩們，執行 B 計畫！

10.en: You are going to be shocked by what I’m about to show you, Mom.
10.zh: 媽媽，你看到我即將展示的東西一定會震驚。

10.en: Hmm. I guess some things look better in photos.
10.zh: 嗯，我想有些東西在照片裡看起來比較好。

10.en: Oh, it’s Dad.
Hi, honey!
I found an absolutely brilliant parking space.
10.zh: 我找到一個非常棒的停車位。

10.en: Great. I’ll meet you at the gift shop, dear.
10.zh: 很好。我會在禮品店和你會合，親愛的。

10.en: I still have to buy that big stick.
Why, it’s—
It’s...
It’s beautiful!
Come on, follow me!
Candace, are you still trying to get the boys in trouble?
10.zh: Candace，你還在試著讓男孩們惹上麻煩嗎？

10.en: No! No, no, this is a great thing.
It’s the nicest thing anyone has ever done for me!
10.zh: 這是任何人為我做過最好的事！

10.en: You know, Candace, this is the second time I’ve climbed up there.
10.zh: 你知道嗎，Candace，這是我第二次爬上去。

10.en: I’m already down half a dress size.
10.zh: 我已經少了半個衣服尺寸。

10.en: Come on, hurry!
Hey, where you goin’?
Hurry, Mom.
You won’t believe it.
Ooh! Finally made it, honey.
Now, what is it you wanted me to see?
You’re right.
It’s beautiful!
Happy birthday, honey.
Now, let’s go find your father.
10.zh: 現在，我們去找你爸爸吧。

10.en: Did you like your birthday present?
10.zh: 你喜歡你的生日禮物嗎？

10.en: Uh-huh.
Well, it was definitely better than the gorilla in the cake.
10.zh: 嗯，它絕對比蛋糕裡的大猩猩好。

10.en: Hey, Candace, I had a break and I thought I’d give you this for your birthday.
10.zh: 嘿，Candace，我休息時想說把這個當生日禮物送給你。

10.en: I saw you looking at it in the gift shop.
10.zh: 我看到你在禮品店看著它。

10.en: A Mt. Rushmore bobblehead.
10.zh: 一個拉什莫爾山搖頭公仔。

10.en: You like it?
Ooh! I absolutely love it.
Great. I gotta get back.
Happy birthday.
This was the best birthday ever.
10.zh: 這是有史以來最棒的生日。
